name: N-3RO/LEGO
description: N-3RO was a droid who worked for Jek-14 on Zoh. He and his fellow droids were castaways who respected Jek-14 for looking after their well-being. Due to his past experience, N-3RO had a hatred for sentient beings apart from Jek-14; whom he revered as the Maker of Zoh. When the Freemakers arrived, N-3RO viewed them as a corrosive influence on the Jek-14 and managed to turn the other droids against them.
